'''Ro''' was an [[officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy|starfleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] who fought in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. By the [[time]] of the [[First Order]], Ro's prowesses had passed into history, and the [[Rank insignia of the First Order|commemorative armbands]] worn by [[sergeant]]s of the First Order's [[First Order military|military]] bore the officer's name in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="TFA VD" /> [[General]] [[Armitage Hux|Hux's]] [[Armitage Hux's First Order monitor|monitor]] wore a [[Clothing|uniform]] with the officer's name on it,<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> designating her as a sergeant.<ref name="TFA VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name Ro first appears on a commemorative armband in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="TFA VD /> The name seems to be a reference to Ro, the son of costume designer [[Glyn Dillon]],<ref name="Dillon">{{Instagram|username=glyn__dillon|url=p/BYtRMGjBZap|name=[[Glyn Dillon]]|date=2017-09-06|quote=This is a new promotional poster for 'The Last Jedi' - I like it because they usually have Poe facing the other way... This way you get to see my boys names in Aurebesh ("Ro & Hal").|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/frsEk}}</ref> who worked on the film {{Film|7}}.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}} credits</ref> Similarly, "[[Hal (Imperial officer)|Hal]]," the name on another commemorative armband,<ref name="TFA VD /> seems to be a reference to Dillon's other son, who is called Hal.<ref name="Dillon" />
